english.notes:
(i) Section 17(3) of the Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Act 2025 provides a defence for a person to prove their action was for the purposes of carrying out, or facilitating the carrying out of, work as a journalist, or for the purposes of the publication of academic research.
(ii) Extra-territorial jurisdiction: see section 20 of the Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Act 2025 in relation to offences committed outside the United Kingdom. (iii) Section 18 provides the circumstances whereby this offence does not apply to internet service providers.(iv) Section 19 sets out the liability when this offence is committed by a body.
